subject: [PATCH RFC v4 0/12] mm: use per-VMA lock in __access_remote_vm for improved monitoring reliability

2026-07-28.patch_summary: This patch renames the function get_user_page_vma_remote() to get_user_page_lookup_vma() to improve namespace clarity and prepare for a new variant of this function that takes a VMA as an argument. The rename is done in multiple files, including arch-specific code and include files. This change does not introduce any functional changes.
